name: Microduck
tagline: Pollen Robotics' little robot duck, walking on a real robot brain.
author: Omo Research
about: Pollen Robotics' open-source Microduck, walking in your world. A physics simulation runs its walking policy and every joint moves in Minecraft, live.

name: GLaDOS
tagline: An original ceiling AI that hangs in your lab and talks back.
author: Omo Research
about: A large articulated AI hangs from your lab ceiling and follows you with her eye. Type !glados in chat to command her, or hold push-to-talk and speak: her answers play from her head.

name: RP1 Humanoid
tagline: RoboParty's open-source humanoid, walking on its own.
author: Omo Research
about: RoboParty's RP1, a 24-joint open-source humanoid, simulated and drawn joint by joint in your world. It shares the lab with Microduck.

name: Fruit Fly Brain
tagline: A whole fruit fly connectome, alive in your world.
author: Omo Research
about: A fruit fly driven by a model of its whole brain wiring diagram, embodied in Minecraft.

name: Omo Voice
tagline: Talk to Omo out loud with push-to-talk.
author: Omo Research
about: Hold a key and talk: Omo hears you and answers out loud, no typing needed.

name: Agent Toast
tagline: A quiet note in game when Hermes or Claude Code finishes.
author: Omo Research
about: Your coding agents keep working while you play. When one finishes, a small toast slides in at the corner of the screen, so you never have to alt-tab to check.

name: Teleporter
tagline: Press J to travel to spawn, your bed or your saved places.
author: Omo Research
about: A clean travel menu. Press J (or type !warp) for one-click trips to spawn, your bed, your last death or any spot you have saved, with fuzzy search.
features: Save any spot with an icon

name: Omo Guide
tagline: Type !guide for a clickable tour of everything in your world.
author: Omo Research
about: New to the world? Type !guide for a clickable tour of the rooms, walls and robots, and how to use each one.

name: Twitch Chat
tagline: Your stream's chat, right in the Minecraft chat box.
author: Omo Research
about: Streaming? Your Twitch chat appears in the Minecraft chat box, so you can follow it without leaving the game.

name: Book Paste
tagline: Paste long text into a book and it flows across the pages.
author: Omo Research
about: Paste any amount of text into a book and quill: it flows across as many pages as it needs.
